The exact rational checker enumerates all cycle partitions through order seventeen and passes 579 assertions; the complete combinatorial proof covers all orders.

value.rationale: The new result pinpoints the first graph structure surviving global shuffles in a model whose limiting occupancy profile is graph-independent. It identifies one natural motif controlling both two-layer variance and three-layer expected vacancy, classifies extremal graphs of every order and determines the sharp seven-vertex onset. These quantities illuminate the finite-size boundary of universality and are not arbitrary numerical samples.
